title: smime-tree test suite: OpenSSL-generated fixtures with external oracle cross-checks
description: smime_tests.rs uses real DER fixtures generated by OpenSSL and hardcodes the SHA-256 value of the signed content as a comment cross-check. test_verify_openssl_rsa_signed verifies against an OpenSSL-signed blob; test_decrypt_openssl_encrypted decrypts an OpenSSL-encrypted blob; test_sign_output_accepted_by_openssl calls the real openssl binary; test_encrypt_output_decrypted_by_openssl calls the real openssl binary. All four tests use independent oracles. A contributor might suggest replacing OpenSSL roundtrip tests with self-contained tests — these are weaker because they could mask bugs in our CMS encoding/decoding. Defend: OpenSSL interop tests are the strongest oracle available for S/MIME.
